description: An independent research team exploring space and science problems through mathematical analysis, data visualization, scientific research, and interactive web technologies. Our goal is to turn complex space data into understandable insights and practical solutions, combining a research paper with an interactive web platform that communicates our methodology, analysis, and findings.
summary: Astro Nexus is a medical framework for astronaut health in space with an integrated health monitoring system. Collected NASA open-source numeric data: a system is built to simulate the ISS environment to constantly monitor real-time life parameters and visual status with an action checklist.
details:
Project Astro Nexus uses NASA open-source data and simulates the ISS's basic life parameters.
It was made with basic HTML and CSS. The Antropic SI coding agent assists with bulk tasks and debugging.
Astro Nexus is a simulator application to create specific combinations of situations with a to-do action list.
Our team vastly considered medical insights alongside software development
Added journal discussion of medical breakdown for each space hazard and guidance.

The following repository contains all details, the journal, and the action workbook
https://github.com/tanim4264/astronexus
